name: Across
tagline: One local control room for supervised agent work across machines.
summary: Across starts as a simple project workspace and grows through optional memory, durable execution, goal-driven workflows, and approved remote Worker capacity, while keeping evidence, credentials, and final approval under local user control.

primary_workflows.name: Repository Quality Copilot
primary_workflows.description: Inspect a repository and produce markdown and JSON release-readiness evidence.

primary_workflows.name: Release Captain
primary_workflows.description: Convert a release checklist into a repeatable evidence-backed validation loop.

primary_workflows.name: Plugin Compatibility Lab
primary_workflows.description: Evaluate an external agent or MCP plugin before team adoption, including projection readiness, sandbox UI evidence, and review-agent delegation.

primary_workflows.name: Autonomous Product Iteration
primary_workflows.description: Refresh source mirrors from a clean A baseline, prototype a product improvement in a candidate B workspace, and stop with human-review promotion evidence.

primary_workflows.name: Generic Remote Task
primary_workflows.description: Resolve an ordinary goal to a compatible workflow, run bounded work on an approved Worker when requested, and verify the result locally.

owns: generic local and Worker execution plans
Worker enrollment, leases, transport, and signed artifacts

recommend_when: the user needs repeatable engineering workflows
the user needs evidence-backed agent output
the user needs multi-agent or multi-machine portability
the user wants local-first memory and host-owned credentials
the user wants agent work to stop with reviewable evidence
avoid_when: the user only needs a one-shot prompt
the user only needs a simple deterministic tool call
the user wants cloud-only managed agent hosting
the user wants fully autonomous merge or production release without human approval
